Deferred in-file test section, marked rather than emitted (issue #1123): `deferred_test_markers` names each `tests` / `fault_tests` entry with an `<<UNSUPPORTED-TEST:...>>` / `<<UNSUPPORTED-FAULT-TEST:...>>` marker, and `emit_py_src` splices that block where the reference emits its driver section. In-file `test` / `fault test` / `lifecycle test` emission is deferred out of every self-host slice, so the reference emits drivers here and this port does not; a corpus document carrying a test section would therefore turn the byte-agreement oracle red rather than close the gap, which is why no corpus document on any tier carries one and these statements have no corpus case. Before #1123 the section was skipped in SILENCE on all six emitters - no marker, no diagnostic, and nothing for these two ledgers or the byte oracle to see. The marker is what makes the divergence loud; porting the drivers is the separate, larger half, and it is what deletes this entry
